review: Sweet Bonanza 1000 applies the same treatment Gates received: identical core gameplay, bigger multipliers and a 25,000x cap. The base game is unchanged, so sessions feel almost the same until the free spins arrive. It's a sensible upgrade for players who already know they like the original's bonus.
cons: Very little new beyond the numbers
